thread:
lina: starting telemetry rendezvous for eu-central-2 GPU cluster. goal: validate logs/metrics/traces ingestion + dashboards + alert templates before handoff to infra-ops.
mike: ETA for full dataset ingestion? I can run traffic replay from canary if needed.
lina: canary replay scheduled in 15m. plz verify ingest keys and agent versions first. checklist below.
sam: copying quick checklist:
```
- confirm fluentd/otel-collector v1.12 deployed to node pool 'gpu-eu-c2'
- logging: ensure stdout->stack driver with label redwood.cluster=eu-c2
- metrics: node_exporter + prom for gpu_exporter
- traces: otel-collector with jaeger exporter -> tracing-pipeline-eu
- dashboards: temp links to /d/eu-c2-telemetry
- alerts: node down / high gpu mem / log ingestion lag
```
oliver: kube-apply for collector done, pods Running. fluentd crashed once, restarted by k8s. logs show OOMKilled earlier.
aisha: OOMKilled likely due to buffer limits. lowered buffer_memory_limit and redeployed.
devops-bot: deploy pipeline #1258 to cluster eu-central-2 succeeded in 2m 24s :white_check_mark:
mike: starting traffic replay now. will push ~200 rps for 10m to simulate batch ingest.
sam: watching prom:gpu_utilization, node:cpu and fluentd_output_latency. I see a spike in fluentd_output_latency ~2s at start of replay.
lina: expected some latency bump. if >5s sustained, we rollback collector to v1.11.
oliver: dashboards provisioned: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/eu-c2-telemetry (temp) — panels for logs/sec, ingestion-lag, promtail_backlog.
aisha: alert template draft:
```
- alert: FluentdHighOutputLatency
  expr: fluentd_output_latency_seconds{cluster="eu-c2"} > 5
  for: 2m
  labels: {severity: "page"}
  annotations: {summary: "Fluentd output latency high in eu-c2"}
```
mike: during replay, logs/sec peaked at 6k/s, ingestion lag max 12s, then stabilized to <1s after batching config tweak.
sam: traces look good; sampled spans reach tracing-pipeline-eu, and flamegraphs for model-serving show normal tail latencies.
lina: cost note — replay increased egress to observability by ~18GB in 10m. mark in provisioning ticket for quota bump review.
oncall-rotation: added eu-c2 alerts to rotation schedule. FYI: paging threshold for gpu_mem_high set to 90%.
mike: small follow-ups: 1) include prefix/KV cache logs in dashboards; 2) add rule for model-serving traceback rate > 5/min.
lina: agreed. I'll update alert templates and push final PR to infra-alerts repo. handoff meeting in 30m with infra-ops.
aisha: leaving one actionable: confirm KMS keys for logs encrypted at rest. created ticket INF-8421.
oliver: all green from my side besides the buffer tuning note. good to hand off after PR + infra-ops ack.
lina: thanks all. summary posted to #eng-infra and I'll pin checklist to the ticket. :thumbsup:
